definition: a man who founds or establishes; a founder.
example_en: The founder of this institution is still popular today.

definition: (masc.) a professional performer of music; a musician.
example_en: At the wedding the band of musicians sang all night.

definition: the condition or quality of being abundant; plentifulness; abundance.
example_en: An abundance of greenery is seen during the rainy season.

definition: anointed; smeared; daubed.
example_en: The paint daubed on the wall dried up.

definition: a register in which details of all incoming mail are registered.
example: ಕಚೇರಿಯ ಆವಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪತ್ರಗಳ ವಿವರ ಇದೆ.
example_en: All the details of the letters are in the office's incoming mail register.

definition: to cause to be crushed, pounded, beaten.
example_en: The stones were made to be crushed in the machine.

definition: to cause to become fat or fatter.
example_en: He made his body fatter by exercising daily.

definition: a vessel (astral tube) in the body the pulsation in which indicates the soundness of the bile-system.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನ ಪಿತ್ತನಾಡಿಯನ್ನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ತಿಳಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor examined his bile-pulse and informed him of his health.

definition: the animal which shaggy fur all over its body; a bear.
example_en: A shaggy-furred animal, a bear, was seen in the forest.

definition: nearness in time; proximity.
example_en: There had been proximity between the two of them for many years.

definition: a post for tethering the elephants.
example_en: The elephant tied to the elephant post swung its trunk.

definition: the fluid form of a substance in which it can expand indefinitely and completely fill its container; form that is neither liquid nor solid; a gas.
example_en: It was found that gas was leaking in the kitchen.

definition: a seasoning of food with oil, spices, asafoetida, etc.
example_en: If you add seasoning to the vegetables, a good aroma comes.

definition: the ocean that is greatly perturbed by stormy, tempestuous weather.
example_en: Due to the storm, the perturbed ocean looked terrifying.

definition: a historian - a) a writer of history; b) an authority on or specialist in history.
example_en: He was a famous historian.

definition: an imperfect vision.
example_en: As he grew old, he developed imperfect vision.

definition: a person who opposes or hates; a foe, an enemy.
example_en: He has more enemies than friends in the whole town.

definition: a school of the Sāma Veda.
example_en: Taḷavukāra is a school of the Sāma Veda.

definition: to cheat; to deceive; to fool.
example_en: That swindler cheated me.

definition: sensation of hotness or warmth felt through the skin; heat; intense feeling of suffering; acute mental pain; agony.
example_en: A sensation of heat appeared in the child's body.

definition: (dial.) a chisel with a wide blade resembling a leaf.
example_en: They carve a wide layer with the leaf-shaped chisel.

definition: to be very anxious with full of mental distress or uneasiness because of fear; to be greatly worried.
example_en: When the son did not come home, the mother was greatly worried.

definition: a vehicle that moves in the sky.
example_en: The flying vehicle was soaring above the clouds.

definition: petty - a) of little or no importance or consequence; b) of lesser or secondary importance; c) having or showing narrow ideas, interests, etc.; d) mean or ungenerous in small or trifling things; e) showing or caused by meanness of spirit.
example_en: Many petty items are sold in the shop.

definition: the peak of a mountain.
example_en: The mountaineers set out to climb the mountain peak.

definition: to feel again and again grief or great sorrow over something.
example_en: She kept grieving again and again over her father's death.

definition: a taking a girl or woman as a wife in marriage.
example_en: He took a girl in marriage and lived happily.

definition: a relatively huge log lying like a rock.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಬಳಿ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಅರೆಗೊರಡು ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A huge log lying like a rock lay near the hill.

definition: a sweet dream.
example_en: She had a sweet dream at night.

definition: a bunch of grapes.
example_en: A bunch of grapes had grown well on the vine.

definition: to pain as a thorn in the flesh.
example_en: The thorn pricked his foot and pained like a thorn in the flesh.

definition: the quality that comforts, solaces, consoles or brings welfare.
example: ಅವಳ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಬಗೆಯ ಹಿತತನ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a kind of comforting quality in her words.

definition: the quality of being courageous or adventurous.
example_en: His courageous nature was known to the whole village.

definition: a kind of pudding made by stuffing it with a sweet preparation.
example_en: They have made stuffed sweet pudding at home today.

definition: (collectively) the profit and loss; advantage and disadvantage.
example: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದ ಪೋಗಾಗು ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಹಾಕಿ ಮಾಲೀಕ ಚಿಂತಿತನಾದ.
example_en: Calculating the business's profit and loss, the owner became worried.

definition: a knot which cannot be untied easily.
example_en: The stubborn knot that formed in that rope could not be untied.

definition: to carry the burden on one's head, shoulder, back, etc.
example_en: The labourers carry sacks of paddy from the field.

definition: a place where village juries generally meet to hear and decide the disputes of local people.
example_en: The disputes of the villagers are settled at the pancagaṭṭe.

definition: an instance of series of questions being asked and getting answers for them.
example_en: A long exchange of questions and answers took place in the meeting.

definition: a supervisor of workers, esp. of coolies.
example_en: The supervisor put the coolies to work.

definition: an earthy clay coloured by iron oxide, usu. yellow or reddish brown, used as a pigment in paints; ochre.
example_en: The painter mixed ochre into the paint.

definition: the act or an instance of catching fire.
example_en: The dry leaves caught fire quickly.

definition: the act of carrying, conveying a load.
example_en: The labourers carried the load of sacks.

definition: the wild, black brown and white bird, Acridotheres fuscus, of starling family; wild myna.
example: ಕಾಡುಮೈನ ಗಿಡದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಹಣ್ಣು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The wild myna was sitting on the tree and eating fruit.

definition: a wicked, rough and violent man.
example: ಆ ದಿಂಡೆ ಊರಿನ ಜನರನ್ನು ಸದಾ ಹೆದರಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That wicked, violent man always frightened the people of the village.

definition: a colourless, crystalline compound, potassium nitrate (KNO3), used in gunpowder, medicine, preservative, etc.; saltpetre.
example_en: Saltpetre is very important in medicine manufacturing.

definition: a killer; a murderer.
example_en: That murderer had struck fear in the village.

definition: the evergreen tree Achras sapota ( = A. zapota, = Sapota achras) of Sapotaceae family; sapota tree.
example_en: The sapota tree has grown thickly in the courtyard.

definition: a bundle of betel leaves (differing in numbers, being twenty, fifty, hundred etc.).
example_en: They had brought ten bundles of betel leaves for the wedding.

definition: an unlucky man.
example: ಆ ದೈವೋಪಹತನಿಗೆ ಯಾವ ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲೂ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಸಿಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That unlucky man did not find success in any work.

definition: the soul, as the inhabitant and knower of the physical body.
example_en: The scripture says the knower dwelling within the body is the soul.

definition: to shut up an animal in a pound.
example_en: The farmers shut up the stray cow in the pound.

definition: smeared; anointed; daubed.
example_en: His whole body was smeared with oil.

definition: a man who makes others laugh.
example: ಆ ನಗೆಕಾರ ತನ್ನ ಜೋಕುಗಳಿಂದ ಸಭೆಯನ್ನು ನಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That comedian made the gathering laugh with his jokes.

definition: an automotive, heavy vehicle for transporting loads along highways, streets, etc.; a truck.
example_en: The truck loaded with sand went to the site.

definition: the act of wandering in a forest; inhabitation in a forest.
example_en: Everyone knew of that hunter's forest-dwelling life.

definition: to throw or fling with force or violence; to cause to fly rapidly through the air from the hand.
example_en: He flung the stone with great force.

definition: any small, rounded, usu. inflamed swelling of the skin; a papule or pustule; a pimple.
example_en: A pimple is rising on his hand.

definition: a distance or measure of four inches.
example_en: The width of that bowl was four inches.

definition: (arch.) one fourth of a rupee; four-annas.
example_en: Only four annas remained with him.

definition: depending upon; relying on; dependent.
example_en: This scheme is dependent upon the government's grant.

definition: a mineral (complex silicate) that crystallize in thin, somewhat flexible, translucent or coloured, easily separated layers, resistant to heat and electricity; mica.
example_en: Mica is a mineral that is found in thin layers.

definition: to eat (food).
example_en: The hungry child quickly ate the food.

definition: a Viṣṇu temple.
example_en: There is a Viṣṇu temple in the middle of the village.

definition: a man with unsteady, capricious mind.
example: ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಲೋಲಿತ, ಒಂದು ಮಾತಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಲ್ಲುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He is a fickle man who does not stick to one decision.

definition: any of several animals that live and breathe in water.
example_en: Many aquatic creatures live in the sea.

definition: green chilli.
example_en: Mother added green chilli to the curry.

definition: the plant Lagenaria vulgaris (= Cucurbita lagenaria) of Cucurbitaceae family and its gourd; bottle gourd.
example_en: Grandmother made sambar using the bottle gourd.

definition: (in pl. only) unevenness; irregular surfaces.
example_en: This road has many uneven, irregular surfaces.

definition: an oblong, woollen scarf worn around the throat or around the head (covering the ears) for warmth.
example_en: She wrapped a muffler around herself for protection from the cold.

definition: a man who does not possess the natural virility.
example_en: The villagers talked that the impotent man did not have children.

definition: to cease to exist; to die.
example_en: That old man died of illness.

definition: the plant Agati grandiflora of Leguminosae family.
example_en: The Agati grandiflora plant bloomed in front of the house.

definition: a species of jujube tree.
example_en: The children were playing under the large jujube tree.

definition: the whitish mass of bubbles formed on or in liquids by agitation, fermentation, etc.; foam.
example: ಸೋಡಾ ಬಾಟಲಿ ತೆರೆದಾಗ ಪೇನ ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ ಉಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: When the soda bottle was opened, the foam surged up.

definition: a broken piece of a pot; a potsherd.
example_en: A potsherd lay fallen on the ground.

definition: undaunted courage.
example: ಆ ವೀರನ ಅಕ್ಷತಧೈರ್ಯ ಸೈನ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: That hero's undaunted courage inspired the army.

definition: to cause to puncture the skin with a needle and insert an indelible colour or colours so as to leave a permanent mark or design; to tattoo.
example: ಅವಳು ತನ್ನ ತೋಳಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೂವಿನ ಹಚ್ಚೆಚುಚ್ಚಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: She had a flower tattooed on her arm.

definition: a man who cowardly flees from the battle-field.
example_en: Everyone scorned him as a coward who fled the battlefield.

definition: a stupid woman.
example: ಜ್ಞಾನಶೂನ್ಯೆ ತನ್ನ ಮಗನಿಗೆ ಪಾಠ ಹೇಳಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The ignorant woman could not teach her son his lesson.

definition: to become superior or supreme.
example_en: Through hard work he became supreme in society.

definition: a large, deciduous tree Bombax ceiba ( = B. malabaricum, = Salmalia malbaricum) of Bombacaceae family; Indian silk cotton tree.
example: ಬೂರುಗ ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ನಿಂತು ರೈತ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: The farmer stood under the Indian silk cotton tree and rested.

definition: food, not cooked; raw food.
example_en: It is not good to eat raw food while travelling.

definition: a boldly-courageous, brave man.
example_en: That brave man did not lose heart before the enemies.

definition: matter that settles to the bottom of a liquid; sediment.
example_en: Sediment remained at the bottom of the oil.

definition: the state of identification of oneself with Brahma, the Supreme Being.
example_en: The seekers performed penance to attain identification with Brahma.

definition: a royal or main road.
example: ರಾಜನ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಉಪನಿಷ್ಕರದ ಮೂಲಕ ನಗರ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The king's army entered the city through the main road.

definition: the tree Lagerstroemia lanceolata of Lythraceae family.
example_en: A Lagerstroemia lanceolata tree stands at the edge of the forest.

definition: a man who has the inclination for disciplined orderly way or manner.
example: ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಶಿಸ್ತಿನ ಓಜೆಗಾಱ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone praised him as a man of disciplined manner.

definition: name of a school of Yajurvēda.
example_en: He learned the Yajurveda in the Maitrayaniya school.

definition: Křṣṇa, as a flute-player.
example: ವೇಣುಗೋಪಾಲನ ಕೊಳಲಿನ ನಾದ ಕೇಳಿ ಗೋಪಿಯರು ಮಂತ್ರಮುಗ್ಧರಾದರು.
example_en: Hearing the flute melody of Krishna as the flute-player, the cowherd women were spellbound.

definition: to attract; to pull towards.
example_en: Her beauty attracted and drew everyone towards her.

definition: a thing that is not accepted; that which is discarded, thrown out as useless, worthless or inferior.
example_en: That suggestion became something rejected by the committee.

definition: an offering of food, fruit, etc. to a deity.
example_en: The priest offered naivedya to the deity.

definition: the space in between.
example_en: There was a space in between the two houses.

definition: the space between two spokes of a wheel.
example_en: A small stone got stuck in the space between the spokes of the wheel.

definition: a village servant whose duty is to channel water through artificial means to agricultural fields.
example_en: The water channel servant directed the canal water to the field.

definition: to trample heavily.
example_en: The elephants trampled the field heavily.

definition: the leguminous tree Tamarindus indica of Caesalpiniaceae family; tamarind.
example: ಹುಣುಸೆ ಕಾಯಿ ಸಾರಿಗೆ ಹುಳಿ ರುಚಿ ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The tamarind fruit gives a sour taste to the curry.

definition: the act of deceiving; an instance of deceiving or being deceived; deception; cheating; fraud.
example: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯ ಜತ್ತಕದಿಂದ ರೈತನು ತನ್ನ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The farmer lost his money because of the merchant's deception.

definition: an honest, sincere man.
example_en: The whole village praises him as an honest, sincere man.

definition: a hollow cylinder of reed, straw, wood or bamboo.
example_en: He drank water from a bamboo tube.

definition: to include, contain (within oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: This organization includes many departments.

definition: a written, painted symbol, picture, graph or a diagram.
example_en: There was a beautiful picture in the book.

definition: a leather bag.
example_en: The traveler kept the money in the leather bag.

definition: to carry the burden on one's head, shoulder, back, etc.
example: ಆ ಬಡ ಹುಡುಗ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೊಡ ಪೊಱುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That poor boy was carrying a pot on his head.

definition: (collectively) dried leaves of a plants; trash; rubbish; refuse.
example_en: The dried leaves of the tree scattered everywhere in the wind.

definition: to pull apart or to pieces with some force; to tear up.
example_en: He tore up the paper in anger.

definition: a cottage the roof of which is made of the leaves of palmyra (Borassus flabellifer) tree.
example_en: There were palmyra-leaf-roofed cottages at the edge of the village.

definition: the imaginary line drawn parallel to the equator; the latitude.
example_en: The latitude of that place is close to the equator.

definition: the occupation of a jeweller.
example_en: His grandfather had practiced the occupation of a jeweller.

definition: to move strategically forward.
example_en: The army moved strategically forward towards the enemy.

definition: a flat expanse on a mountain.
example_en: The pilgrims rested on that flat expanse of the mountain.

definition: to poke with a pointed weapon, goad; to goad.
example_en: They goaded the elephant and made it move.

definition: the lower front part of the human body between the chest and thighs; the abdomen; the belly.
example_en: As he aged, his belly grew.

definition: to face bravely; to confront boldly.
example_en: The boy stood confronting the bullies bravely.

definition: (said of flowers) blown; blossomed; opened; expanded.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ನಂತರ ಪುಲ್ಲ ಹೂವುಗಳು ತೋಟವನ್ನು ಅಲಂಕರಿಸಿದವು.
example_en: After the rain the blossomed flowers adorned the garden.

definition: a kind of potherb.
example_en: The soup made from rajagoli greens was very tasty.

definition: a gait of pleasantly smooth manner.
example_en: That dancer's pleasantly smooth gait captivated everyone.

definition: a cluster or tuft of things growing together; a bunch.
example_en: A cluster of fruits was hanging on the mango tree.

definition: the quality or condition of being fat and strong.
example_en: People were amazed at his fat, strong build.

definition: the stomach of any animal; the craw.
example_en: The hunter removed the fish's stomach.

definition: a respecting and appreciating of one's associates.
example_en: Respecting and appreciating one's associates is important among friends.

definition: to rub, smear or apply oil, ointment or perfume on the skin for cosmetic or healing purpose.
example_en: She rubbed oil on her body.

definition: to contain (within); to include within.
example_en: This book contains many subjects within it.

definition: upto today; till now; so far.
example_en: Till now he has not returned by the way he came.

definition: a man who earnestly attempts, endeavours; a striver.
example_en: Being a striver, he never accepted defeat.

definition: the act of cutting off the head; decapitation.
example_en: As per the king's order, the enemy soldier was decapitated.

definition: a man skilled in an applied art; a craftsman; an artisan.
example: ಆ ಕಾರೇಕಾರ ಮರದ ಪೀಠೋಪಕರಣ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That craftsman makes wooden furniture well.

definition: (dial.) two and a half.
example_en: Two and a half measures of paddy are available in the shop.

definition: a mark, symbol, etc. that is stamped on (something).
example: ಆ ನಾಣ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ರಾಜನ ನಾಣಕ ಮೂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The king's stamped symbol was engraved on that coin.

definition: of or pertaining to this world or earth as contrasted with heaven; worldly; earthly; mundane.
example: ಆ ಸಂತ ಸಾಂಸಾರಿಕ ಸುಖಗಳಿಂದ ದೂರವಾಗಿ ಬದುಕಿದನು.
example_en: That saint lived away from worldly, mundane pleasures.

definition: a subcaste among vīraśaivas, the professon of the members of which is trading.
example_en: That trader from the Bananjiga subcaste earned well in business.

definition: a person who is appointed for reaping.
example_en: The reapers are harvesting the crop in the field.

definition: he who wanders, roams; a wanderer.
example_en: That wanderer lives roaming from village to village.

definition: a living together hormoniously without hostility.
example: ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಪುದುವಾಳು ಇದ್ದುದರಿಂದ ಯಾರೂ ಜಗಳವಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because there was harmonious living between the two of them, no one quarrelled.

definition: the condition of moving to and fro or unsteadily.
example_en: The unsteadiness in the old man's walk was clearly visible.

definition: to rub or scrape slightly, as with the fingernails, to relieve itching; to scratch.
example_en: When her back itched, she scratched it with her nails.

definition: smeared with; anointed.
example_en: His clothes were smeared with oil.

definition: the fact of being spread over a wide area.
example_en: The spread of that forest was very large.

definition: to rejoice greatly; to be full of joy; to be jubilant.
example_en: Hearing the news she was full of joy.

definition: decided; determined.
example_en: The matter was decided in the meeting.

definition: (in comp.) four.
example_en: The word 'nā' meaning four is used in the four directions.

definition: efficient; able; competent.
example_en: That worker is of an efficient, competent nature.

definition: characterised by a relatively or abnormally high temperature; hot.
example_en: The summer wind was blowing hot.

definition: the initial stage of one's youth; adolescence.
example_en: She was very lively at the stage of early adolescence.

definition: a cord or rope made by intertwisting strands of fibre.
example_en: The fishermen wove the net with the twisted cord.

definition: that cannot be broken; unbreakable.
example_en: This glass, being unbreakable, does not break.

definition: a special quality, feature, point, characteristic, etc.; speciality.
example_en: The special feature of this artwork makes it unique.

definition: a lamp held in or that can be carried by, hand.
example_en: He walked in the dark holding a hand-lamp.

definition: to have a deep holen or wound.
example_en: Rama, who fell down, has a deep wound on his leg.

definition: a lord; a king; an owner; a master.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಉಡೆ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The lord of that town took care of the subjects with affection.

definition: a species of non-poisonous snake having stripes on its body.
example: ಆ ಬಂಡೆಯ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಒಂದು ರಾಜಿಲ ಹಾವು ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: A non-poisonous rajila snake was seen under that rock.

definition: to mix, blend (different things together).
example_en: The cook blended the oil and spices together.

definition: day and night.
example_en: The sages performed penance day and night.

definition: the early part of the day when dews form on lawns.
example_en: The children played on the grass during the dewy early hours.

definition: a bent or curving part.
example_en: The bent part of that stick was clearly visible.

definition: swiftness in acting or moving; celerity.
example_en: Because of his swiftness the work finished quickly.

definition: a man whose business it is to lend money at interest; a money-lender.
example_en: He borrowed a loan from the money-lender.

definition: a man who earns his livelihood from carpentry.
example_en: The man who lived by carpentry supported his family by his own work.

definition: Křṣṇa, who holds (and plays) a flute.
example_en: Krishna, the flute-holder, was grazing the cows.

definition: a deep, narrow ditch; a trench.
example_en: There was a deep trench beside the field.

definition: a female dancer.
example_en: The female dancer danced gracefully before the king.

definition: to become famous; to get wide and favourable recognition.
example_en: That singer became famous within a short time.

definition: the state of being insane; mental illness or derangement; insanity; madness.
example_en: He behaved as though madness had gripped him.

definition: a narrow channel along the side of a road or street, to carry off water, as to a sewer.
example_en: Rainwater flowed in the street drain.

definition: a smile sincerely expressing one's kindly and generous nature.
example_en: Her sincere, kindly smile won everyone's heart.

definition: a propitious god.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬದವರು ತಮ್ಮ ಭಾಗ್ಯದೈವವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಪೂಜಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The members of that family worship their propitious god every day.

definition: amounting to fourteen in number.
example_en: Fourteen children were present in the school classroom.

definition: making someone or something the object of scornful laughter by joking; mocking.
example_en: His mocking words angered everyone.

definition: any of the games of chance played for money or some other stakes; gambling.
example_en: Gambling is illegal.

definition: drawn; pulled; dragged.
example_en: The cart was pulled by the oxen.

definition: the main mosque in a city.
example_en: On Friday, people went to the main mosque for prayer.

definition: a shell or cowrie used as currency by primitive people.
example: ಪುರಾತನ ಕಾಲದ ಜನರು ಕಾಗಿಣಿಯನ್ನು ಹಣವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People in ancient times used the cowrie shell as currency.

definition: a more or less cylindrical roll of tobacco cured for smoking, wrapped in a tobacco leaf; a cigar.
example_en: Expensive cigars are available in that shop.

definition: a man who plays a musical instrument.
example_en: That instrument player is skilled at playing the tabla.

definition: a small passage for bringing water into a fortified place.
example_en: Water comes into the fort through a small passage.

definition: the quality or condition of being clean, pure, spotless; cleanliness; immaculateness.
example_en: The officials came to test the purity of the water.

definition: to cause to exert pressure or force to move an object, person, etc.
example_en: He pushed forcefully to open the door.

definition: the early morning (before the sunrise).
example_en: He got up early in the morning and went for a walk.

definition: that which is or is existing, occurring, working, placed, used, etc. beneath the surface of the earth; underground.
example: ಆ ನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಭೂಗತ ರೈಲು ಮಾರ್ಗ ಇದೆ.
example_en: That city has an underground railway line.

definition: a kind of grass that is not eaten by cattle or is not of any use to human.
example_en: Useless grass had grown all over the field.

definition: the inner, softer part of a nut, fruit pit, etc.; the kernel or kernel.
example_en: They took out the kernel of the coconut and made chutney.

definition: the quality of being distinguished or different from what is ordinary or usual; speciality; distinctiveness.
example: ಈ ಕಲಾಕೃತಿಯ ಬಿಸಿಷ್ಟ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The distinctiveness of this artwork drew everyone's attention.

definition: a particular kind of yogic posture.
example_en: The teacher taught the students the Gandabherunda posture.

definition: the liquid left after churning butter from milk; buttermilk.
example_en: In summer, buttermilk is very tasty to drink.

definition: the emphasis (by stress, pitch or both) given to a particular syllable in a word when it is spoken; an accent.
example: ಆ ಪದದ ಮೊದಲ ಅಕ್ಷರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸ್ವರಭಾರ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The accent falls on the first syllable of that word.

definition: any of a family (Gruidae) of usu. large gruiform wading birds with very long legs and neck, and a long, straight bill a crane.
example_en: The crane was walking slowly in the marshland.

definition: made of the metallic element tin; having tin as one of the ingredients (as an alloy).
example_en: This tin vessel must be used carefully.

definition: the quality of bending easily or being flexible.
example_en: Everyone was amazed at the flexibility of this creeper.

definition: the act or manner of walking with longer strides.
example_en: Everyone was amazed seeing the way he walked with long strides.

definition: a series of mountains that look like stacked one above the other.
example: ದೂರದಿಂದ ಅಡಕಿಲ್ಗಿರಿ ಒಂದರ ಮೇಲೊಂದು ಇರುವಂತೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: From afar, the stacked mountains looked as if piled one above another.

definition: the act, responsibility or the office of a caretaker.
example_en: The care of the garden has been entrusted to the son.

definition: a thin liquid.
example_en: There was too much thin liquid in the cooked gruel.

definition: free from affliction, pain, distress.
example_en: Through meditation, his mind became free from affliction.

definition: the act of meddling, interfering into another's or otherś affair without being asked to; officiousness causing annoyance to others.
example_en: Because of his meddling, the two of them quarrelled.

definition: a chequered or colourful carpet.
example_en: They had spread a colourful carpet in the hall.

definition: a situation that arrests the movement or progress or a thing that stops from moving.
example_en: Due to the obstruction on the road the vehicles came to a stop.

definition: (dial.) the unborn young human while still in the uterus, from about eighth week after conception until birth; a foetus.
example_en: The foetus was growing in the mother's womb.

definition: the ability to contain, absorb, receive, hold, react, retaliate, etc.
example: ಈ ಪಾತ್ರೆಯ ಗುಣ್ಮೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ನೀರನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This vessel's capacity holds a lot of water.

definition: a town or city.
example_en: This town is very ancient.

definition: to be charmed greatly; to enchanted.
example_en: He was greatly enchanted by the beauty of the poem.

definition: a disease caused by the malfunction of the liver.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪೈತ್ಯಜ್ವರ ಇದೆ ಎಂದು ಪತ್ತೆ ಹಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor diagnosed that he had a liver-fever disease.

definition: a man who is inclined to quarrel with another.
example_en: Being a quarrelsome man, he was fighting with everyone.

definition: all the people living in a particular district, city, etc. ; a community.
example_en: The whole community participated together in the festival.

definition: to cause to wear (as a garment ornament, etc.
example_en: The grandmother made her granddaughter wear the bangles.

definition: ruined; spoiled; desolated.
example_en: The crop was ruined by the rain.

definition: the fact of receiving, inheriting from one's ancestor.
example_en: He received the ancestral property by inheritance.

definition: the rule, reign of a lord.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರಾಂತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಈಶಶಾಸನ ಶತಮಾನಗಳ ಕಾಲ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The lord's rule continued for centuries in that province.

definition: a man who carves wooden dolls.
example_en: That carver carved beautiful wooden dolls.

definition: a drawing or other representation, usu. on a flat surface, of all or part of the earth's surface ordinarily showing countries, bodies of water, cities, mountains, etc.; a map.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಭಾರತದ ನಕಾಶವನ್ನು ಹಲಗೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಡಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher drew a map of India on the board.

definition: a man of noble descent.
example: ಆ ಕುಲಜ ತನ್ನ ವಂಶದ ಗೌರವ ಕಾಪಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That man of noble descent upheld the honour of his lineage.

definition: the fact of being subject to births and deaths.
example_en: Living beings seek liberation from the cycle of births and deaths.

definition: one who betrays both the rival sides crossing from one side to the other.
example: ಆ ಇಬ್ಬಂದಿ ಎರಡೂ ಕಡೆಯವರಿಗೂ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That double-crosser betrayed both rival sides.

definition: (a formal or respectful term) to come in.
example_en: The Maharaja graciously came into the court.

definition: a swine, Sus scrofa.
example_en: The swine was lying beside the field.

definition: to bring together a large number of people to form a mob.
example_en: The leader brought people together into a mob and held a meeting.

definition: a man who is enjoying or having a pleasurable experience of something; an enjoyer.
example_en: That enjoyer was experiencing the pleasure of music.

definition: a bag or bulb in to fill the air with.
example_en: They filled the bulb with air and tied it.

definition: a man who is indebted or obliged to another under obligation, moral responsibility or gratitude.
example_en: After taking the loan, he became indebted to him.

definition: money paid or to be paid for transportation in a train, taxi, plane, etc.; fare.
example_en: The train fare has increased from today.

definition: the act of eating (food).
example_en: He was absorbed in the eating of the festival food.

definition: a community whose trade is basically trading.
example_en: The Ibbakula community have been trading since ancient times.

definition: a woman.
example: ಆ ವಾಸಿತೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಊಟ ಬಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: That woman served food to the children lovingly.

definition: the quality of behaving in arrogant, haughty way or tendency of showing wilful disrespect, despise, etc.
example: ಅವನ ದಪ್ಪ ವರ್ತನೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಬೇಸರ ತರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His arrogant, haughty behaviour annoyed everyone.

definition: the act of quarreling involving physical fighting; conflict; strife; contention.
example_en: A fight broke out between the two friends.

definition: the act, fact or an instance of bending, leaning towards (one side); slantness; inclination.
example_en: The wall's inclination is dangerous to the building.

definition: the honey or sweet fluid secretion of flowers; the nectar.
example: ಅಲರ್ವಂಡು ಹೂವಿನ ಎಸಳುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಹನಿಹನಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The nectar of the flower stood in drops on its petals.

definition: (a dog, wolf, etc.) to utter the characteristic long, loud, wailing cry; to howl.
example_en: As soon as night fell, the dog started to howl.

definition: the state or quality of being low.
example_en: He explained the low quality of that vowel's tone.

definition: the quality or state of being absurd, unreasonable, ridiculous; nonsense; absurdity.
example: ಅವನ ವಾದದ ಚಿಟುಮಿಟಿ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ನಗೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The absurdity of his argument became the cause of laughter for everyone in the assembly.

definition: to cause to join, adhere or blend with or together.
example: ಅಂಟನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಅವನು ಎರಡು ಚೂರುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಾಳಾಸಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: Using glue, he made the two pieces adhere together.

definition: to decide firmly upon; to determine.
example_en: He determined firmly to travel.

definition: something spoken in coded or secret language.
example_en: The spies sent the message in coded, secret language.

definition: to be hanging or suspended.
example_en: The creeper was hanging from the tree.

definition: destruction; ruin.
example_en: The war caused the destruction of the whole city.

definition: an aged man.
example_en: That aged man was sitting in front of the temple.

definition: a distance of approx. three miles, ued as a unit of linear measure.
example: ಆ ಊರಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಎರಡು ಹರಿದಾರಿ ದೂರ ಇದೆ.
example_en: That village is two haridaris (about six miles) from here.

definition: the quality of a wicked person; wickedness.
example_en: His wickedness eventually led to his punishment.

definition: the offensive smell of urine.
example_en: The offensive smell of urine hit my nose.

definition: a ratio that can be expressed in a different ratio interchanging the position of the denominator of one fraction with the numerator of another, but without changing the relation (as the relation between the ratios a/c = b/d and a/b = c/d).
example_en: The mathematician proved the alternate ratio through a formula.

definition: any organism that feeds upon dead or decayed organic matter.
example_en: Scavengers swarmed over the dead animal.

definition: to face in opposition.
example_en: The soldier faced the enemy courageously in opposition.

definition: to reduce to powder or fine particles by crushing and friction; to grind; to powder; to pulverise.
example_en: She ground the rice on the stone.

definition: (hist.) a British gold coin valued at 20 shillings or one pound sterling; a sovereign.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ವಧುವಿಗೆ ಪವನು ನಾಣ್ಯ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In those days, a sovereign coin used to be given to the bride.

definition: a way, path, road.
example: ಈ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಹಳೆಯ ದಾರಿ.
example_en: This is the old path leading to the temple.

definition: a small pouch for rosary.
example: ಜಪಕವಳಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ನೊಣದಿಂದ ರಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಅವನು ಅದನ್ನು ಒಳಗಿಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He kept the rosary pouch inside to protect it from flies.

definition: to be resplendent; to shine brilliantly.
example_en: The golden finial shines brilliantly atop the temple.

definition: to decorate ornament; to embellish.
example_en: The daughter embellished her hair with flowers.

definition: to carry to the destination.
example_en: The cart driver carried the grain to the town.

definition: (acting, talking, eating, drinking, spending money, etc.) as one pleases; without check or restraint; wildly.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಅವನು ಸಿಕ್ಕಾಪಟ್ಟೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He spent wildly, without restraint, on the festival day.

definition: a seller of gems.
example_en: That gem seller was selling gems in the market.

definition: the cardinal number fifty; 50.
example_en: He is now fifty years old.

definition: a building for playing games; a sport-house.
example_en: The children were playing in the sport-house.

definition: Allah, the Muslim name for God.
example_en: Muslims believe Allah to be the one and only God.

definition: a kind of nettle.
example_en: Nettle plants have grown thick at the edge of the forest.

definition: cursed; under a curse; damned.
example_en: No one lived in that cursed village.

definition: to hold or squeeze firmly with a pair of scissors.
example_en: He held the thread squeezed firmly with the scissors.

definition: a very small bit; particle; a speck.
example_en: The dust particles from the road had settled on the clothes.

definition: (the look or form of the body) to be spoiled; to become ugly.
example_en: Due to illness his body's form kept becoming spoiled.

definition: a drain, usu. underground, for carrying off water and waste matter; a sewer.
example_en: The city's sewer overflowed during the rainy season.

definition: wave or waves caused by the vibration of something.
example_en: The vibration wave caused by the explosion spread far.

definition: a man who flies kites.
example: ಆ ಪಟಗಾರ ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಗಾಳಿಪಟ ಹಾರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That kite-flier flew a colourful kite in the sky.

definition: any of the different varieties or populations of human beings distinguished by physical traits such as hair, eyes, skin color, body shape, etc.; a race.
example_en: There are many races in the world.

definition: (usu. used in dupl.) the imitative sound of ringing bells.
example_en: The temple bell rang with a ganagana sound.

definition: a year.
example: ಒಂದು ವರಿಷದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಅವನು ಇಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He came here a year ago.

definition: to strike heavily; to bang.
example_en: The attackers struck heavily against the fort's gate.

definition: a short story or entertaining account of some happening.
example_en: The grandfather told the children a short story.

definition: to make a sign, gesture, indication communicating something.
example_en: He made a sign with his hand.

definition: the lock and the key.
example_en: The lock and key of the treasury were handed over to the officer.

definition: absence of connection; disconnection.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗೆ ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ವಿಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಇನ್ನೂ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The lack of internet connection is still a problem for that village.

definition: the depression in the center of the surface of the abdomen indicating the point of attachment of the umbilical cord to the embryo; the navel.
example_en: The doctor examined the infant's navel.

definition: originated, made or produced long back.
example_en: This is an old custom, they still observe it even now.

definition: the act of removing or taking off.
example_en: The old paint was removed from the wall.

definition: the buttocks or posteriors of a woman.
example: ಆ ನರ್ತಕಿಯ ನಿತಂಬದ ಚಲನೆ ಬಹಳ ಆಕರ್ಷಕವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The movement of that dancer's hips was very graceful.

definition: intense anger; wrath.
example_en: Intense anger welled up in his mind.

definition: a machine for printing from inked type, plates or rolls; a printing machine.
example_en: The newspapers were printed on the printing machine.

definition: a big cup with a handle, used for taking out liquid from a container; a mug.
example: ಅವಳು ಬಾವಿಯ ನೀರನ್ನು ಮೊಗಪೆಯಿಂದ ಎತ್ತಿ ತೆಗೆದಳು.
example_en: She scooped up the well water with a mug.

definition: that which is piping hot.
example_en: He served piping hot tea.

definition: a conference of people belonging to the same profession.
example_en: A conference of teachers was arranged at the school.

definition: a net made of thin straps of leather.
example_en: The hunter spread the leather-strap net in the forest.

definition: the quality or fact of being oblique; obliqueness; slant.
example: ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಿರುಕಿನ ವ್ಯಾಕುಂಚಿತ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The obliqueness of the crack on the wall was clearly visible.

definition: a woman belonging to Musalman religion.
example_en: The Muslim woman went to the mosque and prayed.

definition: in a good or satisfactory manner.
example: ಅವನು ಎಲ್ಲ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ತೆರಂ ಮಾಡಿ ಮುಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He finished all the work in a satisfactory manner.

definition: any of several acute, inflammatory virus diseases, caused by herpesvirus, characterised by the eruption of small blisters on the skin and mucous membranes.
example_en: Herpes zoster appeared around his waist.

definition: any colourful flower.
example_en: Colourful flowers have bloomed in the garden.

definition: a kind of large spoon for pouring liquid.
example_en: The cook served the curry with the large ladle.

definition: a jar with a seive-like bottom (for filtering liquids).
example_en: She filtered the milk using the sieve-bottomed jar in the kitchen.

definition: the quality or fact of having lucidity in presentation , considered as a merit in rhetoric.
example_en: The lucidity of expression in this poem pleased the readers.

definition: the tree Madhuca malabarica ( = Bassia malabarica) of Sapotaceae family.
example_en: The Madhuca malabarica tree grows on the riverbank.

definition: a hostile or contrary action; contrariety; opposition.
example_en: Opposition grew between the two groups.

definition: the process or procedure, of submitting or dedicating.
example_en: They carried out the procedure of offering flowers to the god according to the scriptures.

definition: to move or be moved quickly and irregularly up and down, back and forth or from side to side; to vibrate; to shake.
example_en: The wall of the house shook during the earthquake.

definition: the central hall of a temple.
example_en: The devotees were seated in the central hall of the temple.

definition: the brightness of the sun.
example_en: At dawn the brightness of the sun lit up the whole sky.

definition: a kind of eatable, dish.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ಮಿಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಎಂಬ ಸಿಹಿ ತಿಂಡಿಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother made a sweet dish called miṭṭige for the festival.

definition: to wet (something) thoroughly in a liquid; to soak.
example_en: The rice must be soaked for an hour before cooking.

definition: crop grown in a field.
example: ಈ ಬಾರಿ ಗೋಧಿ ಫಸಲ್ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: This time the wheat crop has come out well.

definition: a manengaged in manufacturing, productive or business activity.
example_en: There are many businessmen in that town.

definition: to make (a fruit) ripen; to ripen.
example_en: The farmer ripened the bananas by keeping them in dry straw.

definition: the ruddy goose, the male and female of which are supposed to be together always.
example_en: The ruddy geese floated in pairs on the pond.

definition: anything used to embellish something or someone; an ornament.
example_en: They dressed the child in golden ornaments.

definition: to vehemently long for; to desire.
example_en: She vehemently longed for her mother's love.

definition: to cause to swell.
example_en: The hot water caused his hand to swell and made it hurt.

definition: an elder sister.
example: ಅಂತಿ ಮದುವೆಯ ನಂತರ ಬೇರೆ ಊರಿಗೆ ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: The elder sister moved to another town after her marriage.

definition: the capital of Tamil Nadu, now called as Chennai.
example_en: He went to Madras in search of employment.

definition: particularly; mainly; to a marked degree; especially.
example_en: He alone is mainly the cause of this riot.

definition: a kind of sweet cake.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ನಮಗಾಗಿ ಪೌಲಿ ಎಂಬ ಸಿಹಿ ತಿಂಡಿ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother made a sweet cake called pauli for us.

definition: wet, soft earth or earthy matter, as on the ground after rain, at the bottom of a pond or along the banks of a river; mire.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ನಂತರ ಕೆರೆಯ ದಂಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಱೊಂಪೆ ತುಂಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the rain, the lake bank was full of mire.

definition: to make into a bundle; to wrap or tie together.
example_en: She tied the clothes into a bundle and kept them.

definition: an aimless shot or stroke.
example_en: That aimless shot did not hit the target at all.

definition: to make foul, dirty or unclean; to pollute; to debase.
example_en: Throwing garbage pollutes the water.

definition: a close or intimate relative.
example_en: He always respected the advice of his close relatives.

definition: the rear extremity of anything.
example_en: They placed the sacks at the rear end of the cart.

definition: an able, capable man.
example_en: That capable man can do all the tasks.

definition: the chief officer of a village.
example_en: Everyone respected the village chief's words.

definition: a piece or fragment separated from a whole.
example_en: A piece of the cloth got torn.

definition: to serve food.
example_en: They served hot food to the guests.

definition: this manner, way or order.
example_en: If the work is done in this manner, it will finish quickly.

definition: to be unquiet or restless.
example_en: The children were restless all night and did not sleep.

definition: lack of honesty; a disposition to lie, cheat or steal; deceiving; dishonesty.
example_en: The clerk's dishonesty was exposed in the accounts.

definition: a harvested field.
example_en: The farmers gathered the grains fallen in the harvested field.

definition: a metal plate nailed to the hooves of oxen, horses, etc. for protection; a shoe.
example_en: The blacksmith nailed a shoe to the horse's hoof.

definition: a hairless head; a baldy scalp.
example_en: As he grew old, he became bald.

definition: a man who has invested capital in a business enterprise; an investor; a capitalist.
example: ಬಂಡವಾಲಶಾಹಿ ತನ್ನ ಲಾಭವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The capitalist reinvested his profit.

definition: the act of entering; entrance.
example_en: The entrance to the house was small.

definition: a kind of poetical conversation, in the form of a song, sung by a group of persons hailing the excellence of women over men (as a sport)[the counterpart of this hailing the excellence of men is turā].
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರು ಕಲ್ಗಿ ಹಾಡುತ್ತಾ ರಾತ್ರಿಯೆಲ್ಲಾ ಕುಣಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers danced all night singing the kalgi song.

definition: to try (vehemently or with a resisting force) to get freed from another's grip.
example_en: The child struggled vehemently to free its hand from the grip.

definition: a diplomatic representative appointed by one country or government to represent it in another; a diplomat.
example_en: The diplomat was welcomed with honor in the royal court.

definition: a group associated for some purpose, as to form a commercial or industrial firm.
example_en: That company was engaged in the cloth trade.

definition: the state of being not aware of one's own existence, sensations, thoughts, surroundings, etc; unconciousness.
example_en: The injured person was unconscious for a few moments.

definition: an unfavourable report esp. one that is implicative.
example_en: There was an implicative unfavourable report in that news.

definition: Yamunā river, one of the major rivers of North India.
example: ಕಳಿಂದಕನ್ಯೆಯ ಪವಿತ್ರ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಕ್ತರು ಸ್ನಾನ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The devotees bathed in the holy water of the Yamuna river.

definition: a woman whocuts, severs; a cutter.
example: ಆ ಕೊಯ್ಕೆ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬತ್ತವನ್ನು ಕುಶಲತೆಯಿಂದ ಕೊಯ್ದಳು.
example_en: That woman cutter skillfully harvested the paddy in the field.

definition: a kind of (sweet ?) dish.
example_en: Mother prepared sanjurige for the festival.

definition: a person characterised by opportunism.
example_en: In politics, he was recognized as an opportunist.

definition: a harlot; a prostitute.
example_en: A prostitute lived in that town.

definition: a moving in the sky; space-voyage.
example_en: Scientists carried out research on the space-voyage.

definition: (said of the heart) to palpitate, throb rapidly (as from fear, anxiety, etc.).
example_en: His heart was palpitating with fear.

definition: a quarrel - a) a dispute or disagreement, esp. one marked by anger and deep resentment; b) a falling out; breaking up of friendly relations.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕಚ್ಚೆ ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A quarrel started between the two over a small matter.

definition: the soil that is rich in salts such as sodium chloride or potassium nitrate.
example_en: The saline soil in this field is not suitable for cultivation.
